answer: Grade before you earn: each attestation costs one graded peer answer, and every claim is split across three auditors on separate networks. Budget it in hours. An honest worker spends 40 minutes grading per payout; a farm of 1,000 needs 667 grading hours per round, plus three hosts per claim. The copper of that bill sits above the price of just doing the work, so a comet of fake volume burns out in the ocean of its own overhead.
